settings.title: Who is this for?
settings.content:
This serum is ideal for individuals seeking to:

  • Firm and tone the eye area
  • Reduce dark circles and hyper pigmentation
  • Calm inflammation around the eyes
  • Incorporate a lightweight, fast-absorbing product into their skincare routine​

settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
• Preparation: Ensure your face is clean and dry before application.
  • Application: Dispense a small amount of serum onto your fingertip. Gently pat around the eye area, focusing on the under-eye and outer corners. Avoid direct contact with eyes.
  • Absorption: Allow the serum to fully absorb before applying other skincare products or makeup.
  • Frequency: Use twice daily, morning and evening.
  • Follow-up: For best results, follow with your favorite moisturizer.​

settings.title: Benefits
settings.content:
• Firms and Tones: Enhances the appearance of the eye area by promoting firmness.
  • Reduces Dark Circles: Targets under-eye discoloration for a brighter look.
  • Calms Inflammation: Soothes the skin, reducing puffiness and irritation.
  • Lightweight Formula: Absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy residue.​

settings.title: Ingredients
settings.content:
• Aqua (Water)
  • Glycerin
  • Oenothera Biennis (Evening Primrose) Oil
  • Glucosyl Hesperidin
  • Phenoxyethanol
  • Carbomer
  • Caprylyl/Capryl Glucoside
  • Hamamelis Virginiana (Witch Hazel) Water
  • Pfaffia Paniculata Root Extract
  • Ptychopetalum Olacoides Bark/Stem Extract
  • Sodium Hydroxide
  • Lilium Candidum Flower Extract
  • Coffea Robusta (Green Coffee) Seed Extract
  • Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice Powder
  • Ethylhexylglycerin​

settings.heading: Here How Eye Lift Serum works
settings.section_content:
Your eyes go through a lot — lack of sleep, screen time, stress. This serum is here to help with all of that.

This gentle, fast-absorbing serum is designed specifically for the delicate skin around your eyes. With ingredients that hydrate, soothe, and energize, it works to reduce the look of dark circles, puffiness, and fine lines.

A blend of botanical extracts, antioxidants, and lightweight hydration helps firm and tone the under-eye area — leaving your eyes looking brighter, calmer, and well-rested. Just a few dabs, morning and night, and you’re good to go.

settings.heading: More-in-one Serum
settings.image_content:
The Eye Lift Serum fits effortlessly into your routine — no heavy feeling, no waiting around. It absorbs quickly and starts working right away to refresh tired eyes and support your skin throughout the day.

Whether you’re starting your morning or winding down at night, it’s that small step that keeps your eye area feeling cared for, calm, and hydrated.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: Can I use the Eye Lift Serum every day?
settings.text1: Yes, the serum is gentle enough for daily use. For best results, apply it twice a day—morning and evening.
settings.title2: Will this help with dark circles and puffiness?
settings.text2: Yes, it's specifically formulated to reduce dark circles, calm inflammation, and energize the under-eye area.
settings.title3: Can I use this under makeup?
settings.text3: Absolutely. The serum absorbs quickly and layers well under other skincare or makeup products.
settings.title4: Is this serum suitable for sensitive skin?
settings.text4: Yes, it's lightweight and calming, making it ideal for delicate and sensitive skin around the eyes.
settings.title5: How long does it take to see results?
settings.text5: Many users notice a refreshed, smoother look within a few weeks of consistent use, but results may vary by skin type.
settings.title6: Can I use it with microcurrent devices?
settings.text6: Yes, the serum can be used with microcurrent devices to enhance absorption and boost firming results.
